claims.summary: The deployed v0.15.49 console log showed repeated export-sourced finish passes after Download ZIP clicks, with no ZIP-save exception.
ExportSidePanel now treats a terminal finished package receipt as the handoff to ZIP download rather than rerunning finish.
The new guard only bypasses finish when structural readiness has no blockers; quality blockers remain visible through package trust and bundled reports.
A focused regression recreates the terminal 74/C quality-blocker receipt and proves Download ZIP calls the ZIP exporter instead of onFinishPackage.
